title: fix(app-shell): the metadata admin detail header wraps instead of overprinting the breadcrumb at narrow widths (objectui#12306)
body:
Fixes #12306
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

I measured before changing anything (table below). The overprint is in the compact one-line header that `PageShell` renders when an item is named, which is an item page such as the permission set matrix editor (`/_console/apps/setup/metadata/permission/showcase_contributor?scope=environment`). The card names the permission LIST page. Its hero header does not overprint at 820px: 0 overlapping text boxes, and its screenshots are byte-identical before and after this change. The runner's reading "All Metadata T…SECURITY Pe create-only P…" matches the compact header exactly. "Pe" is the "Permission Set" type link showing between the SECURITY and create-only chips, and "P…" is the truncated subtitle "Permission set".

Mechanism: the compact header was a `flex items-center gap-3` row that never wrapped. Its chip, stat and action groups were `shrink-0`, the breadcrumb `nav` was `min-w-0`, and the breadcrumb's own links were `shrink-0`. On a row too narrow for all of them, flexbox shrank the `nav` box (to 0px at an 820px window). Its links then overflowed it and painted underneath the chips. At a phone width the action group was also pushed past the right edge, where the console main area's `overflow-x-hidden` hid History, Save and Clone to customize.

## The change (one place: `PageShell`, the shared header of every metadata admin page)

- The compact header row wraps (`flex-wrap`, `gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5`).
- Everything after the breadcrumb (chips, subtitle, stats and actions) is one cluster with `flex-auto`. Its basis is its content width. When it cannot sit beside the breadcrumb, it moves to the next line as a whole. The breadcrumb keeps a line of its own and truncates the item name only when that line is narrower than the breadcrumb. `flex-1` would set a zero basis, which always "fits", and the squeeze would come back. The pin and a source comment both say so.
- Stats and actions sit at `ml-auto`, replacing the `flex-1` spacer, so they stay right-aligned on whichever line they land. They wrap among themselves only when even a line of their own is too narrow.
- The list page's hero header is untouched, and so is `ResourceListPage.tsx`.

## Browser measurement, before (`068a540`) and after (`6476ffc`)

**How it was rendered.** The repo `verify` skill's preview gallery renders designers but not `PageShell`. No backend was available in this container: the sibling objectstack checkout is neither installed nor built. So a scratch Vite entry, not committed, mounted the real `PageShell` inside the real console geometry:
- the `@object-ui/layout` `AppShell`;
- an icon-collapsible `Sidebar` driven by the real `useResponsiveSidebar`, so at 820px it auto-collapses to the 48px rail as the console does;
- the `main` classes copied from `ConsoleLayout`, and the console's own `index.css`;
- the exact props `PermissionMatrixEditor` and `ResourceListPage` pass for the stock showcase `permission` type: domain `security`, `allowRuntimeCreate: true`, item `showcase_contributor` and two stats. The actions are History plus Clone to customize for a code-shipped set, and History plus Save for a writable one.

It was driven by Playwright Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) with windows 900px high.
- **Overprints** counts pairs of painted text or icon boxes, from different elements, that intersect. Each box is first clipped to its overflow-clipping ancestors, so an ellipsized name counts only its visible part.
- **Cut off** counts painted boxes that leave the header box.

| Page (window width) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Matrix editor, code-shipped set (820) | One line. Breadcrumb box 0px wide for 230px of content; item name 0 of 141px visible; 6 overprints | 3 lines (breadcrumb / chips and subtitle / stats and actions). Breadcrumb 376px, item name in full; 0 overprints |
| Matrix editor, writable set (820) | One line. Breadcrumb 57px wide for 230px of content; 5 overprints | 2 lines (breadcrumb / everything else); 0 overprints |
| Matrix editor, either set (390) | Breadcrumb 0px; 6 overprints; 6 boxes cut off past the right edge (one stat, History, Save or Clone) | Breadcrumb on its own line, item name ellipsized to 106 of 141px; 0 overprints, 0 cut off |
| Matrix editor, writable set (1440) | One line | Screenshot byte-identical |
| Matrix editor, either set (1920) | One line | Screenshot byte-identical |
| List page hero header (390, 820, 1440, 1920) | 0 overprints | Screenshot byte-identical at all four |
| Matrix editor, code-shipped set (1440) | One line. Item name ellipsized to 84 of 141px, subtitle ellipsized; 0 overprints | 2 lines, full item name and subtitle; 0 overprints. This is the one change at a wide window; see the open question below |

Header height in px, before and after: 820 code-shipped 57 and 105; 820 writable 57 and 79; 1440 code-shipped 57 and 79; 390 57 and 135.

## Tests

- **New pin** `PageShell.narrowHeader-12306.test.tsx`, 5 cases. happy-dom lays nothing out, so it pins the class contract that lets the browser wrap:
  - the row wraps;
  - the row holds the `nav` and ONE cluster, which contains the chips, subtitle, stats and actions;
  - the cluster is `flex-auto` (not `flex-1`), `flex-wrap` and `min-w-0`;
  - the breadcrumb is `min-w-0` and the item name truncates, with its `title`;
  - the stats and actions group is `ml-auto flex-wrap justify-end`.
- **Ablation**, run on committed `6476ffc` through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor must hit exactly once; the mutation and the restore are proven by blob hash):
  - Leg A restores the old row classes (`flex items-center gap-3 min-h-[44px]`). Result `Tests 1 failed, 4 passed (5)`; the failing case is "the header row is a wrapping flex row".
  - Leg B swaps the cluster's `flex-auto` for `flex-1`. Result `1 failed, 4 passed`; the failing case is the basis case.
  - Each leg was restored: blob equals HEAD `4b737bc`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Suite run.** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` at `6476ffc` gave `Test Files 478 passed (478)` and `Tests 5435 passed, 1 skipped (5436)`. 478 is the number of tracked test files under that directory, so the pin and every suite that renders `PageShell` ran.

## Gates (all at `6476ffc`)

- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2`: 28 successful, 28 total.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: the script echoed as `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, exit 0.
- **eslint**, narrowed to the changed files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the three changed files, run from the repo root against the root config.
  - eslint's own JSON classifies the changeset as "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied". It lints the other 2 files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - Why the narrowing is safe: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so no rule is type-aware, and no repo rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the disk. This diff therefore cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
  - The full `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- **Repo checks.** Each passed (exit 0) and printed its own pass line:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`
  - `pnpm check:changeset-claims`
  - `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations)
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`
  - `pnpm check:test-path-roots`
  - `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`
  - `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`
  - `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape`
  - `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`
- The `check:i18n-*` family was not run: no string was added.

## Acceptance notes

- **Which page.** The collision is on the item page header, not on the list page the card names, and the list page header is unchanged. The fix sits where the card's claim put it, in the shared `PageShell`, once.
- **Same defect at phone width.** At 390px the compact header's actions were pushed off the right edge and could not be reached. The wrapping row fixes this too, with no extra change.
- **Pin hook.** `data-testid="page-shell-header-meta"` was added for the pin. No export, prop, type member, spec key or i18n key is added. `Clause-②: no`.
- **Rendering method.** The before and after readings come from the scratch harness described above, not from a live showcase. The harness mounts the real component and layout, but the stats values (9 and 0) and the item name are stand-ins.

## Open question for the seat

At a 1440px window, a code-shipped permission set's header (History plus Clone to customize) does not fit on one row even before this change. It used to stay on one line by ellipsizing the item name. It now wraps to two lines and shows the full name. This PR treats that as part of the fix: it is the same squeeze, and it simply had not yet hidden the name.
- **A (this PR):** wrap whenever the row does not fit.
- **B:** let a small shortfall ellipsize the item name before wrapping. That needs the breadcrumb to declare a smaller line-breaking basis than its content and to out-grow the cluster, which means a magic grow ratio. At some content widths the type links could then be squeezed again.

Recommendation: A.
